items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I knew her when she was in the Cotton Club chorus

ctx.x: And we worked together out there in California, and when I come back, first thing I know, he had a trio, and the next thing I know he was singing and became a big star, you know. And Billy Daniels, everybody that you could name I've been contacted in the music business somewhere along the line either writing for them or playing with them or working with them.

In fact, Cab Calloway had mostly everybody at that time that was working with us doing theaters and shows. So just about any -- that goes for Bill Robinson, goes for Lena Horne. I mean, I knew her when she was in the Cotton Club chorus, and that goes for anybody you can name in the show business. I can tell you something about, you know, my relationships with them.
When you were with Cab, Dizzy hadn't come in the band yet or --
